Container.Name: spinseek
Container.Overview: Self-hosted Lidarr companion: search or batch-paste albums, get AI or Last.fm recommendations, preview tracks, and send exactly the albums you want (standard editions) to Lidarr with an indexer-safe search queue.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Holds spinseek.db (settings, library mirror, ratings, queue).

Config.Name: Login username
Config.Description: Optional fixed login (set both username and password). Leave empty to create the login in the browser on first start; nothing is accessible until a login exists.

Config.Name: Login password
Config.Description: Optional. Used together with the login username.

Config.Name: Encryption key (APP_SECRET)
Config.Description: Optional. Encrypts stored API keys. Leave empty to auto-generate /config/.secret_key. Set before first start; changing it later means re-entering API keys.

Config.Name: Trusted reverse proxy (TRUST_PROXY)
Config.Description: Optional. IP of your reverse proxy (e.g. 172.17.0.1) so login rate limiting sees real client IPs. Leave empty if you don't use one.
